title: Independent audit of RULE-02 and Director-authorized integration into main
actor: Claude Code agent (architect/QA reviewer role) on Director request, local WSL session

changes.description: Audited Codex commit 481735d (RULE-02, CHG-20261011-002) against the backlog acceptance (reproduce relevant upstream tests; compile/run the selected adapter under Node 24; no Bun-only production dependency), ADR0008 and ADR0009. Present: 347 vendored files (304 runtime, 43 test-only) at pin 53a79413 with Git blob/SHA-256 lock, both MIT notices, two reproducible patches (P001 matcher preload, P002 disabled environment tracing) that change no assertion or rule logic; precompiled kernel with only mutative, @logtape/logtape and seedrandom; server adapter and trust-free Lab worker with closed bounded input, explicit player authority and fail-closed admission; Bun 1.4.2 hash-pinned and test-only; artifact v3 engine/provenance binding. Code review covered the importer, closure walker, integrity verifier, Bun installer, boundary checker, artifact/release changes and Dockerfile.

Independent local runs RUN-20261011-065..072 all passed at executable fingerprint 831cb35f…: engine:check; importer reproduction from the pinned checkout; a separate git cat-file byte audit (345 identical, 2 patched, licenses, no extra/missing files); a compiled-adapter authority/input/admission probe; upstream 338 pass/1 inherited skip/0 fail across 27 files; two Chromium workers; verify:foundation 124 checks (100 Node + 24 Python); and the host isolated 13-stage CI pipeline with a fresh image and owned cleanup. RUN-20261011-073 docs:check covers this record.

Append an independent-audit section to docs/validation/rule-02.md with results, cross-checks and the randomness/clock sources RULE-03 must replace; update the handoff with the audit, the Director-authorized integration and next actions.

The Director authorized pushing and merging RULE-02 once the audit confirmed it. Publish codex/rule-02-engine-vendor and claude/rule-02-audit; fast-forward main to the commit containing this record. No history rewrite.

limitations: Local Dev Container and local Docker evidence only; the hosted foundation workflow for the integrated main commit must be observed separately.
The audit does not certify rules, cards, randomness, replay, viewer privacy, Windows/GPU/touch behaviour, ARM64 execution or production; those gates remain with RULE-03/04, PLAY-02 and later tasks.
The Director clarification splitting RULE-02 from RULE-03/04/PLAY-02 is recorded by Codex; it matches the backlog task definitions but the original instruction was not observed by this auditor.
